viewing_check: Look for 9ct / 375 stamps on each charm and the jump ring (hallmark photo with loupe), and weigh all three pieces on scales, since weight sets the gold value. Check whether the castle and well really are gold (not gilt) and whether the crab disc is gold or rolled gold; check the well bucket and castle top open and are undamaged.
